chapterTitle: The Diplomatic-War Strategy: Negotiate While Advancing
coreMove: Advance pressure while offering a real settlement path so the opponent can compare the cost of continued conflict with a believable exit.
reversal: If the negotiating channel is fake or insulting, the opponent stops trusting the exit and fights harder.
teachingEmphasis: pair pressure with a real settlement lane
make the off-ramp face-saving enough to be usable
treat diplomacy as leverage only when the exit is sincere
avoid decorative negotiation that masks pure coercion
